comparison.objective: Set cable tension and lock it with a toggle clamp, versus set a gripper angle and lock it with a jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a measured mechanical setting while actuating a lock, then release; the candidate adds coaxial driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cable remains straight and the gauge carriage stays in the green band after clamping and release, analogous to retained angle after locking.
comparison.reason: Both principally test preserving an adjusted mechanical value while locking it and verifying hands-off retention; different geometry and lock hardware do not establish a meaningfully different ability.
